info.name: E_commerce-backend
info.description:
API collection for the E-commerce backend service.

- Two top-level folders: **User App** (customer-facing) and **Admin** (back-office).
- Each folder carries its own bearer token (`{{userToken}}` / `{{adminToken}}`), auto-populated by the `login` requests' test scripts.
- IDs (user, product, cart, order, etc.) are collection variables auto-captured from `create`/`list`/`login` responses where possible, so requests can be run top-to-bottom (or via Collection Runner) without manual edits.
- Set `baseUrl` to point at any environment (local/staging/prod).
